instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that combines a 2-to-4 decoder with an active-low enable input and active-high outputs, and a 2-bit adder with carry-in and carry-out functionality. The module should have two input bits (A and B), an enable input (EN), and four output bits (Y0-Y3). When the enable input is low, the output corresponding to the binary value of the input should be high, and all other outputs should be low. Connect the decoder outputs to the adder inputs such that the adder output is equal to the binary value of the selected output. Use the pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
